invoices.none: This PO has no invoice yet. Finance records invoices on the invoices page.

changes.none: This PO has no change yet
changes.noneCanChange: This PO has no change yet. Press "Change PO" to change prices, quantities, the delivery date or the notes to the supplier.
changes.changeHint: A change of prices or quantities is approved under the DOA rule for PO changes

sendRevision.title: Revision not sent yet
sendRevision.body: Revision {no} is approved but not sent to the supplier yet
sendRevision.confirmBody: An e-mail with the latest PDF goes to the supplier. Once sent it cannot be called back.

draft.title: Milestones and retention
draft.intro: Set while the PO is a draft
draft.noLines: Only a line of a service PO ordered for one request and not split yet splits into milestones, so this PO has none

milestones.title: Split line {no} into milestones
milestones.description: {description} · {quantity} {uom} · 2 to 12 milestones whose shares add up to 100%
milestones.sumWrong: The shares must add up to 100%; they add up to {sum}% now
milestones.badShare: Type every milestone's percentage as a number above 0, e.g. 30 or 33.33

retention.title: Retention
retention.percentHint: Held back from every invoice of this PO; 0 for none
retention.daysHint: Leave empty for the organization's default
retention.badPercent: Type a percentage from 0 to 100 with at most 2 decimals
retention.badDays: Type the days as a whole number

page.title: Change PO {number}
page.intro: Change prices, quantities, the delivery date or the notes to the supplier. A change of prices or quantities is approved under the DOA rule for PO changes; a change of only the delivery date or the notes is approved when it is sent.
page.notChangeable: A PO in this status is not changed. It can be changed once approved, sent to the supplier or received.
page.forbiddenHint: Only procurement changes POs. Ask procurement if this PO needs a change.
page.doaMissing: The DOA has no rule for PO changes yet. Ask the organization's DOA administrator to add it first.

form.step1: Step 1 of 2: the lines to change
form.step2: Step 2 of 2: delivery date, notes and reason
form.quantityMerged: This line orders several requests, so its quantity stays
form.priceLocked: This line has an invoice, so its price stays
form.badQuantity: Type a quantity above 0 with at most 4 decimals
form.badPrice: Type the price as a number with at most 2 decimals
form.next: See the new totals and go on
form.totalsTitle: The PO's totals after the change (worked out by the system)
form.totalsTable: The PO's totals before and after the change
form.deliveryHint: Leave empty when there is no delivery date
form.reason: Reason for the change (the approvers see it)
form.reasonMissing: Type the reason for the change
form.disposition: What happens to the quantity taken off

dispositionOption.RETURN_TO_POOL: Back to the source request's lines waiting to be ordered

open.title: Change no. {no}
open.draftHint: This draft is not sent yet. Check it, then press "Send the change".
open.draftAutoHint: This change is of the delivery date or the notes only: it is approved when sent
open.pendingHint: Waiting for approval under the DOA rule for PO changes. The PO changes once every step approves.
open.approved: Change sent and approved at once, as it is of the delivery date or the notes only
open.cancelBody: The budget reserved for it comes back and its open approval task closes

errors.PO_CHANGE_OPEN: This PO has a change that is not finished. Send or cancel it before making another.
errors.PO_CHANGE_BELOW_PROGRESS_RECEIVED: The new quantity of line {lineNo} is below what was received. Type at least what was received.
errors.PO_CHANGE_BELOW_PROGRESS_INVOICED: The new quantity of line {lineNo} is below what was invoiced. Type at least what was invoiced.
errors.PO_CHANGE_BELOW_PROGRESS_LINE_INVOICED: Line {lineNo} has an invoice, so its price stays. Keep the price as it is.
errors.PO_CHANGE_EXCEEDS_REQUEST: The new quantity of line {lineNo} is more than the source request has left ({left} left). Lower the quantity.
errors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: The DOA has no rule for PO changes yet. Ask the organization's DOA administrator to add it first.
errors.BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT: The budget line does not have enough for the increase. Lower the price or quantity, or move budget first.
errors.MODULE_DISABLED: The organization has not switched on tier-2 finance
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone changed this document meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: The document's status no longer allows this. Reload the page to see where it stands.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The document was not found. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back, so it is not certain this was saved. Press the same button again without changing anything.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again and try again.
errors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No approver was found under the DOA rule for PO changes. Ask the administrator to check who holds the positions.
errors.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: The DOA has no one with enough authority for this amount. Ask the DOA administrator to check the PO change rule.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: Not allowed: it breaks the separation of duties
errors.EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR: The e-mail was not sent. Try again later.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Tell the administrator the reference {requestId}.
errors.VALIDATION_NO_CHANGE: Nothing changes yet. Change a quantity, a price, the delivery date or the notes.
errors.VALIDATION_MERGED_LINE: Line {lineNo} orders several requests, so its quantity stays and it does not split
errors.VALIDATION_SHARES: Shares are 2 to 12 milestones, each above 0, adding up to 100%
errors.VALIDATION_NOT_SERVICE: Only a service PO splits into milestones
errors.VALIDATION_MISSING: The supplier has no e-mail address. Add one in the supplier register before sending.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are not right. Check them and try again.
errors.other: This did not go through. Try again; if it still fails, tell the administrator.

task.heading: PO change
task.amountsTitle: The PO's totals after the change
task.approveHint: Once approved the PO becomes a new revision, and procurement sends it to the supplier
